verdict.rationale: vLLM's continuous batching and chunked prefill (vllm-docs-3) let many requests/prompts be processed together efficiently, and community reports confirm this batching foundation is used for bulk workloads (vllm-comm-3), but the evidence pack has no explicit bulk/batch API (e.g., an OpenAI-style batch endpoint) or documentation of submitting large item lists as a single operation. Missing for 10: explicit batch API/endpoint docs, guidance on submitting bulk jobs, and independent confirmation of large-scale bulk throughput results.
